habit.description: After blocking a projectile the Oni dashes straight in. Throw a second projectile or meet the dash with a throw or anti-air before it arrives.

notes: Anti-air (YOK-165): answers opponent_jumping with oni-medium-punch (8f startup, club swing y170-270), the single attacking answer so jump_punish_pct sets the rate. Oni patient (Y2): walks in, punishes whiffs; the whiff punish is a dash_forward stand-in for the Iron-Club Charge. Oni normals now exist in data/moves but this profile still uses only generic actions plus the anti-air; close-range pokes and the Iron-Club Charge are not wired in yet.
